    Statements of the brick-accessibility theorems #

    This file uses only Mathlib. It fixes the vocabulary of the frozen manuscript Brick accessibility for brick-finite special biserial algebras and states its three principal results:

    • TheoremA (Theorem 5.4): over a basic finite-dimensional brick-finite special biserial algebra over an algebraically closed field, every nonsimple brick has a brick submodule or a brick quotient of dimension one less;
    • CorollaryB (Corollary 5.5): every brick is brick accessible, and the brick dimensions of a nonzero such algebra form an interval {1, …, N};
    • CorollaryBiserial (Corollary 5.6): both conclusions for representation-finite biserial algebras.

    Conventions follow the manuscript. Modules are right modules, that is, modules over Λᵐᵒᵖ. Paths are multiplied in traversal order: for arrows a : x → y and b : y → z the path ab goes from x to z, and the arrow a maps M e_x to M e_y on a right module M. All modules in the statements are finite-dimensional.

        source
        inductive BrickAccessibility.Statement.FinQuiver.PathRel (k : Type u) [Field k] (Q : FinQuiver) :
        FreeAlgebra k Q.Gen → FreeAlgebra k Q.Gen → Prop

        The defining relations of the path algebra: the vertex idempotents are orthogonal and sum to one, and each arrow is fixed by the idempotents of its source (on the left) and target (on the right).

        • idem {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (v w : Q.V) : PathRel k Q (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl v) * FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl w)) (if v = w then FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl v) else 0)
        • one {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} : PathRel k Q (∑ v : Q.V, FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl v)) 1
        • src {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) : PathRel k Q (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl (Q.src a)) * FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a)) (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a))
        • tgt {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) : PathRel k Q (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a) * FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inl (Q.tgt a))) (FreeAlgebra.ι k (Sum.inr a))

                  Bound quiver presentations #

                  source
                  structure BrickAccessibility.Statement.AdmissiblePresentation (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] :
                  Type (max 1 u)

                  An admissible bound quiver presentation Λ ≅ kQ/I: a surjective algebra homomorphism π : kQ → Λ whose kernel I is admissible, that is, R^m ⊆ I ⊆ R² for some m ≥ 2, where R is the arrow ideal. Here R^m is spanned by words of m arrows and R² is the span of the words of at least two arrows.

                  • Q : FinQuiver

                    The quiver.

                  • π : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q →ₐ[k] Λ

                    The quotient map kQ → Λ.

                  • surjective : Function.Surjective ⇑self.π
                  • nilpotent : ∃ (m : ℕ), 2 ≤ m ∧ ∀ (l : List self.Q.A), l.length = m → self.π (FinQuiver.word k self.Q l) = 0

                    Some power of the arrow ideal lies in I.

                  • ker_le_sq (z : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q) : self.π z = 0 → z ∈ Submodule.span k {y : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q | ∃ (l : List self.Q.A), 2 ≤ l.length ∧ y = FinQuiver.word k self.Q l}

                    I lies in the square of the arrow ideal.
